newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia issues bulletin on Yeltsin's health.
newsitem.headline: Russia issues bulletin on Yeltsin's health.

text.p: The Kremlin issued on Tuesday the first of what it said would be a regular series of bulletins on Boris Yeltsin's health.

The bulletin confirmed that Yeltsin was entering the final stages of preparation for his heart operation and said that doctors were concentrating on bringing him to the peak of his physical and psychological potential.

A Kremlin spokesman said the bulletin, which appeared on Itar-Tass news agency, had been drawn up by the head of the presidential medical centre, Sergei Mironov. "From now on such bulletins will be regular," he said by telephone.
The bulletin reiterated the contents of a statement made on Monday by Kremlin spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky.

"From this week the final stage of the preparation for President Boris Yeltsin's operation has begun. Various degrees of functional tests will be undertaken and there will be round-the-clock monitoring," the bulletin said.
"The main aim of the final stage of the preparation is to bring the patient to the peak of his current physical and physiological capabilities."
